description: Every search call declares its effectors as {kind, fragment, why} across sixteen kinds (quoted phrase, or-group, intitle, author anchor, source filter, year window, cited-by walk, language pivot, zero rescue, existence probe…) with typed term provenance. Anatomy-less searches are rejected and not budgeted.
